summary: Verified bug fix: Kepala Labor can now access /laporan without being redirected to /masuk. Backend export endpoints (xlsx/pdf) return 200 for kepala_labor, tata_usaha, and admin. UI navigation via nav--laporan link works; report-rows table renders; filters (f-status, f-room, f-apply) present. Negative test confirms kalab still blocked from /dasbor/admin (redirected to /masuk).

issues: Date inputs use browser default mm/dd/yyyy picker instead of shadcn calendar component; minor design nit not related to current bug

seed_data_creation: None. DB had 2 pre-existing bookings visible in the report.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for kepala_labor access to /laporan and export endpoints has been fully verified end-to-end (backend curl + Playwright UI). All three roles OK. Negative auth guard still works.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously ROLES_REPORT in App.js only allowed ['tata_usaha','admin'], and backend require_role for export.xlsx/pdf omitted kepala_labor. Both were updated to include kepala_labor, so Protected route no longer redirects kalab to /masuk and exports return 200.
